items.title: To trace this glamorous, awful story is to uncover the secret history of neoliberalism itself.
items.description:
To trace this glamorous, awful story is to uncover the secret history of neoliberalism itself.

It’s also very amusing.

item.title: Instead what they did was build a class of pseudo-enlightened white-collar “creatives” whom we were constantly urged to admire and respect—even as actual creative workers went to the wall and blue-collar America watched its way of life come to an end.
item.description: Instead what they did was build a class of pseudo-enlightened white-collar “creatives” whom we were constantly urged to admire and respect—even as actual creative workers went to the wall and blue-collar America watched its way of life come to an end.

item.title: Tax cuts, privatization, deindustrialization, bank deregulation—every one of these decisions was made with the hope that it would somehow help to rekindle American innovativeness, jump-start our national genius for coming up with useful new things.
item.description: Tax cuts, privatization, deindustrialization, bank deregulation—every one of these decisions was made with the hope that it would somehow help to rekindle American innovativeness, jump-start our national genius for coming up with useful new things.

item.title: Americans love to talk about thinking different and the power of the human imagination, but from the Cold War right down to yesterday’s announcement about AI, these same ideas have also served as the self-justification of our post-industrial plutocracy.
item.description: Americans love to talk about thinking different and the power of the human imagination, but from the Cold War right down to yesterday’s announcement about AI, these same ideas have also served as the self-justification of our post-industrial plutocracy.

item.title: It is the story of the biggest, loudest, buzziest buzzwords of them all: Creativity & Innovation, and our seventy year infatuation with these two ideas. “The Creativity Con” traces all the things we have imagined these words mean and all the things we have done in their name.
